integrity: Closed-form differential-geometric derivation and reproducible symbolic/finite numerical checks; no independent external validation.
scientific_limitations: Constant-curvature 2D space forms; smooth squared-distance chart; fixed inward-relative frame angle; small-step implicit solution. The exact midpoint bisector solution exists for 0<h<2, but uniqueness is claimed only on the local small-step branch. No proof for variable curvature, arbitrary objectives, or globally multiple roots.
title: Sharp curvature-sign angular drift in frame-ordered Itoh–Abe descent
